name: @gjsify/integration-nativescript
description: Local-only smoke suite: runs gjsify nativescript portable/native packages (@gjsify/path, @gjsify/buffer, @gjsify/stream polyfill slot + @gjsify/native-platform native slot) on the NativeScript V8 runtime via @gjsify/nativescript-vite, asserting pass/fail from logcat markers. Validates the declared `nativescript` runtime slots actually execute on-device. Requires the NativeScript CLI + an Android emulator — NOT wired into CI, and excluded from the root workspace (heavy optional NS toolchain).

scripts.clear: gjsify clear platforms hooks dist *.log tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
